card.name: The word through before feeding tubes
card.fires_on: The word "through" (or "via", or the "a"/"the" after it) right after administer, drink or given, where a tube or straw is expected next.

modes.label: Through before a tube
modes.description: "through" after administered or administer, leading into a nasogastric, gastric or feeding tube.
modes.example: The contents of the XTAMPZA ER capsules (microspheres) may be administered<< through>> a nasogastric tube or gastro

modes.label: Through before a straw
modes.description: "through" after drinks the solution, leading into a straw.
modes.example: Ensure that the patient drinks the solution<< through>> the provided straw.

modes.label: Article after through or via
modes.description: The "a" or "the" that follows through or via, just before the tube or straw.
modes.example: The diluted solution may be administered via<< a>> nasogastric tube.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict tube, straw or mouth as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the word "through" when a drug is being given by feeding tube or straw.
